scope: Apparatus and measurement diagrams beside practical methods; shared artwork reused in the practical-skills chapter.

placements.heading: Practical: resistance of a wire and resistor combinations
placements.purpose: Ammeter in series; voltmeter across the selected wire length between fixed and movable contacts. A ruler measures that length.

placements.heading: Practical: resistance of a wire and resistor combinations
placements.purpose: Series and parallel resistor circuits, each with an ammeter measuring total current and a voltmeter across the whole combination.

placements.heading: Practical: investigate I–V characteristics
placements.purpose: Low-voltage supply, variable resistor, ammeter and test component in series; voltmeter across the component.
